name: Glyph Rain
desc: Falling columns of luminous dot-matrix glyphs cascade down the screen with white-hot leading heads and phosphor-fading tails that flicker and mutate as they drop — classic Matrix digital rain rendered in green, amber, ice-cyan, rainbow, or skeletal bone.

density.doc: how many columns rain at once (coverage)

energy.doc: head brightness, flicker rate & beat surge

style.doc: render philosophy: phosphor=green+white head, amber-crt=vintage amber, cyan-ice=cold blue, spectral=rainbow columns, bone=skeletal white wireframe glyphs on black
